reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism aligns with known lattice distortion effects in single-phase HEAs, albeit it simplifies other possible interactions (e.g., short-range ordering).
reasons.testability: Clear in situ dynamic tests comparing dislocation behavior and mechanical response in HEAs vs. a conventional alloy under identical conditions offer a direct path to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a focused mechanistic explanation of dynamic strengthening in HEAs and proposes a concrete experimental comparison to advance understanding in this area.
